note: Computed 10.703° vs ALSJ computed reconstruction 10.65°: delta +0.053° (tolerance ±0.5°). The historical value is a reconstruction, not an in-situ measurement. With the ALSJ table's older site coordinates (0.6875, 23.4333) the pipeline gives 10.663° (-0.040° from the LROC-coordinate value).
